---
title: Use the Interactive TUI
---

The terminal UI runs ad hoc queries with the same agent, parser, sources, tools,
traces, and history serialization used by batch execution. Each submitted query
is an independent agent run; visible transcript history is not added to the
next query's model context.

### Start the TUI

```bash
searcher inspect --config-path configs/demo --config-name config
searcher tui --config-path configs/demo --config-name config
```

Hydra overrides can follow the command options:

```bash
searcher tui --config-path configs/demo --config-name config \
  agent.llm_client.model=Qwen3-8B
```

The TUI also reads `LLM_PROVIDER`, `LLM_MODEL`, `LLM_API_KEY`, and
`LLM_BASE_URL` from `.env` by default. Select another file with `--env-file`.
Explicit environment values are applied to the composed client config.

### Run one interactive query without the full UI

Use `--query` to exercise the interactive streaming and recording path from a
normal terminal:

```bash
searcher tui --config-path configs/demo --config-name config \
  --query "Which component owns tool-call parsing?"
```

This is useful for smoke tests and environments where a full-screen terminal
application is inconvenient.

### Slash commands

Type `/` to open the command menu.

| Command | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `/models` | Select a discovered model for subsequent runs |
| `/sources` | Select the active source for subsequent runs |
| `/thinking` | Show or hide assistant reasoning blocks |
| `/tool-detail` | Toggle compact and full tool interaction details |
| `/clear` | Clear the visible transcript |
| `/quit` | Exit the TUI |

Model and source changes apply only to subsequent independent runs. Commands
that mutate session state are rejected while a query is active; cancel the
current query first.

### Records and traces

The default record directory is `outputs/interactive`, or
`<output_path>/interactive` when the run config defines `output_path`.

```bash
searcher tui --config-path configs/demo --config-name config \
  --interactive-output-path outputs/tui-sessions
```

Each query writes a timestamped JSON record and a trace. Completed, failed, and
cancelled runs are all persisted with their event stream, message history,
timing, statistics, and error information. Use these artifacts when promoting
an interactive experiment into a batch configuration.
